request: The AtomicLevel HTTP handler treats a PUT as form-encoded whenever its media type is application/x-www-form-urlencoded, regardless of parameters such as charset=UTF-8 or the letter case of the type, and changes the level from the form's level field.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: fix: accept parameters in AtomicLevel form content types (#1587)

trigger.input:
printf %s '' | base64 -d > http_handler_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run '^(TestAtomicLevelServeHTTP)$' . >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi

defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
